evidence_slice: HM Revenue & Customs' official GOV.UK publication 'Maps of Freeport East tax sites' lists Gateway 14 as one of the Freeport East tax-site map documents. The page states that these tax sites are designated and recognised in law as geographical areas where businesses can benefit from tax reliefs, and that the Freeport East tax-site designations took effect on 30 December 2021.
binding_method: statutory HMRC tax-site designation plus official map record; canonical parcel boundary binding delegated to local OpenCode
source_file_sha256_reason: The official GOV.UK publication page was accessed and identifies the Gateway 14 map, but raw PDF bytes were not acquired through the selected public web transport; no source-file hash or polygon coordinates are fabricated.
